name: ListSync
description: ListSync automatically syncs your watchlists from IMDb, Trakt, and Letterboxd with Overseerr/Jellyseerr. No more manual adding - just add movies and shows to your favorite watchlist, and they'll appear in your media server automatically.

variables.name: Overseerr - User ID
variables.description: User ID # you want the movies or shows to be added under.

variables.name: Overseerr - Use 4K Quality Profile
variables.description: Request Quality Profile (true for 4K, false for standard)

variables.name: Automated Mode
variables.description: Set to true for automated mode (recommended for regular syncing and Docker), false for interactive mode (recommended for quick start)

variables.name: IMDb Lists
variables.description: Comma-separated list of IMDb list IDs to use. See documentation: https://github.com/Woahai321/list-sync/pkgs/container/list-sync#-obtaining-list-ids

variables.name: Trakt Lists
variables.description: Comma-separated list of Trakt list IDs to use. See documentation: https://github.com/Woahai321/list-sync/pkgs/container/list-sync#-obtaining-list-ids

variables.name: Letterboxd Lists
variables.description: Comma-separated list of Letterboxd list IDs to use. See documentation: https://github.com/Woahai321/list-sync/pkgs/container/list-sync#-obtaining-list-ids
